title: Sandbox-runtime gets the patched zod
description: `pnpm audit` has failed on main for two weeks on GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (high), which marks zod below 4.6.6. Our packages are past it, but `@anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime` 0.0.81, its latest release, needs `zod ^3.25.0` and resolves to 3.25.76. sandbox-runtime imports only `zod/v3`, and zod 4 still ships that entry, so a pnpm override can move it to 4.6.7 with the same API. Record the choice as a decision in docs/architecture/decisions/.
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm audit --prod` reports no known vulnerabilities, and zod 3.25.76 is gone from the lockfile
sandbox-runtime still runs a sandboxed command and refuses an invalid settings file
A decision file records why the override is safe
